item.title: Timmons, Scott combine for 43 points to lead Alabama women 76-64 past Tennessee in SEC Tournament
item.description: Jessica Timmons and Ta'Mia Scott combined for 43 points to lead Alabama 76-64 past Tennessee in the second round of the Southeastern Conference tournament on Thursday.

item.title: LeBron James breaks Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's NBA record for career field goals
item.description: LeBron James has become the NBA's leader in career field goals.

item.title: Wembanyama has 38 points and 16 rebounds in the Spurs' 121-106 win over the Pistons
item.description: Victor Wembanyama had 38 points, 16 rebounds and five blocks and the San Antonio Spurs never trailed in completing a sweep of Detroit, beating the Pistons 121-106 on Thursday night.

item.title: Forsberg's 3-point game, Wood's 2 goals lead Predators past Bruins 6-3
item.description: Matthew Wood scored twice to lead the Nashville Predators to a 6-3 victory over the Boston Bruins on Thursday night.

item.title: Connor Hellebuyck makes 26 saves in the Jets' 4-1 win over the Lightning
item.description: Connor Hellebuyck made 26 saves, Mark Scheifele had a goal and an assist and the Winnipeg Jets beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 4-1 on Thursday night.

item.title: Trae Young brings plenty of excitement to the court in limited minutes in his Wizards debut
item.description: Trae Young had 12 points and six assists in just over 19 minutes in his first game with the Washington Wizards.

item.title: Etute, Fiso lead second-half rally as Oregon women beat No. 14 Maryland 73-68 in Big 10 Tournament
item.description: Ehis Etute and Katie Fiso combined for 32 second-half points to lead Oregon 73-68 past No. 14 Maryland in the second round of the Big 10 Tournament on Thursday.

item.title: North Koreans stay perfect at the Women's Asian Cup, beating Bangladesh for its 2nd win
item.description: Midfielder Myong Yu Jong scored her fourth goal of the Women's Asian Cup to lead North Korea to a 5-0 win over Bangladesh and its second victory in group play.

item.title: Bulls hold off the Suns 105-103 for their 2nd win in 3 games after an 11-game skid
item.description: Collin Sexton scored 30 points and the Chicago Bulls held off the Phoenix Suns 105-103 for their second victory in three games following an 11-game losing streak.

item.title: Greer, Wooten combine for 20, Colorado women advance in Big 12 Tournament with 55-48 win over Kansas
item.description: Colorado beat Kansas 55- 48 and advanced in the Big 12 Tournament behind strong defense and balanced scoring.
